Our Story

Rooted in stillness, grown through practice.

Zen with Parmeet began as a single mat in a sunlit living room and grew into a full studio because our founder believed calm shouldn't be a luxury — it should be a daily practice, open to every body and every level of experience.

We blend traditional yogic philosophy with a modern, grounded approach: slow down, breathe with intention, and build strength from the inside out. Every class is designed to meet you exactly where you are.

Our Philosophy

Movement as medicine — mindful, unhurried, sustainable.

Our Mission

Make genuine wellbeing accessible to our whole community.

How It Works

Booking & payment, made simple

From your first message to your first class — here's exactly how it works.

1

Message us

Reach out on WhatsApp or fill the contact form below and tell us what you're looking for — group class, private lesson, or online.

2

Pick your slot

We'll share available timings and help you choose the class or plan that fits your schedule best.

3

Book your free demo

Try your first class on us — no payment needed until you're ready to commit to a plan.

4

Confirm & pay

Loved it? Choose a plan — we'll share the payment details with you on WhatsApp and confirm your spot right away.
